name: Misty Pine Refuge
summary: Misty Pine Refuge is a small outpost building of the Argent Dawn tucked amidst the frigid snows of central Dun Morogh.

sections.title: Shelter in the Snow
sections.body: Situated amid the windswept hills of Dun Morogh, Misty Pine Refuge is an unassuming outpost of the Argent Dawn in the dwarven realm. While the surrounding crags are patrolled by Ironforge mountaineers, the refuge is home to Father Gavin, the order's lone agent here, who offers a quiet hearth amid the bitter elements and the perils that threaten the mountain roads.

faq.answer: It is an outpost building of the Argent Dawn in central Dun Morogh, kept by a single agent of the order, Father Gavin.

faq.q: Why is the Argent Dawn here in Dun Morogh?
faq.answer: While the Argent Dawn focuses primarily on the undead menace in the north, agents like Father Gavin keep watch from quieter corners of the Alliance's lands as well.
Father Gavin, an agent of the Argent Dawn, is the only member of the order stationed at the refuge.

angles.text: Father Gavin's humble post demonstrates that the Light's service often lies in quiet vigilance far from the battlefields.
